title: Retail CDTM Schedule II through V prohibition
rule_summary: A retail collaborative practice agreement may not authorize the pharmacist to prescribe Schedule II through V controlled substances.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply controlled substances requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Retail CDTM Schedule II through V prohibition

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing controlled substances with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
